Fun fact: changing the power level of a microwave doesn't actually change the power. It's actually designed to only output one amount of power, so the other modes simply turn it off and on again every few seconds, which is why you'll hear periodic changes in the noise when you run your microwave on partial power.

So yeah, just replicate this by pressing the on and off buttons every ten seconds.
